The revised Policy will be effective 180 days from when the revised Policy is posted in the Service and your continued access or use of the Service after such time will constitute your acceptance of the revised Privacy Policy. We therefore recommend that you periodically review this page.

    5. Payment Info

  2. How We Collect Your Information:

  3. How We Use Your Information:

    We will use the information that we collect about you for the following purposes:

    2. Creating user account
    3. Testimonials
    4. Customer feedback collection
    5. Processing payment
    6. Support
    7. Administration info
    8. Manage customer order

    10. Dispute resolution

  4. How We Share Your Information:

    We will not transfer your personal information to any third party without seeking your consent, except in limited circumstances as described below:

    1. Ad service
    2. Sponsors
    3. Marketing agencies
    4. Legal entities

    6. Payment recovery services

    We require such third party’s to use the personal information we transfer to them only for the purpose for which it was transferred and not to retain it for longer than is required for fulfilling the said purpose.

  5. Retention Of Your Information:

    We will retain your personal information with us for 90 days to 2 years after users terminate their accounts or for as long as we need it to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected as detailed in this Privacy Policy. We may need to retain certain information for longer periods such as record-keeping / reporting in accordance with applicable law or for other legitimate reasons like enforcement of legal rights, fraud prevention, etc. Residual anonymous information and aggregate information, neither of which identifies you (directly or indirectly), may be stored indefinitely.

Cookie Policy

Effective Date: 16-Feb-2024
Last Updated: 16-Feb-2024

What are cookies?

This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are and how we use them, the types of cookies we use i.e, the information we collect using cookies and how that information is used, and how to manage the cookie settings.

Cookies are small text files that are used to store small pieces of information. They are stored on your device when the website is loaded on your browser. These cookies help us make the website function properly, make it more secure, provide better user experience, and understand how the website performs and to analyze what works and where it needs improvement.

How do we use cookies?

As most of the online services, our website uses first-party and third-party cookies for several purposes. First-party cookies are mostly necessary for the website to function the right way, and they do not collect any of your personally identifiable data.

The third-party cookies used on our website are mainly for understanding how the website performs, how you interact with our website, keeping our services secure, providing advertisements that are relevant to you, and all in all providing you with a better and improved user experience and help speed up your future interactions with our website.

Types of Cookies we use

Manage cookie preferences

Cookie Settings

You can change your cookie preferences any time by clicking the above button. This will let you revisit the cookie consent banner and change your preferences or withdraw your consent right away.

In addition to this, different browsers provide different methods to block and delete cookies used by websites. You can change the settings of your browser to block/delete the cookies. Listed below are the links to the support documents on how to manage and delete cookies from the major web browsers.

Chrome: https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/32050

Safari: https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/safari/sfri11471/mac

If you are using any other web browser, please visit your browser’s official support documents.

html.en:
Cancellation Policy

At Excursions Tickets Direct, we understand that plans can change unexpectedly, and we strive to offer our customers a hassle-free experience. Our cancellation policy is designed to provide flexibility and accommodate various situations.

1. Standard Cancellations

Customers can cancel their bookings up to 24 hours before the scheduled activity day without incurring any charges. This gives you the freedom to adjust your plans in advance, no questions asked.

2. Cancellations Due to Health-related Issues

We prioritize the well-being of our customers and acknowledge that unforeseen health issues may arise. In such cases, we accept cancellations with the condition that a valid medical slip from a certified doctor is provided as proof. This ensures that your genuine health concerns are addressed with empathy and understanding.

3. Rescheduling Options

Life is unpredictable, and we get that. If, for any other reason, you find yourself unable to make it for your scheduled trip, we offer the convenience of changing your booking to another suitable day. This way, you won’t miss out on the amazing experiences we have to offer.

Our primary goal is to create a positive and enjoyable experience for our valued customers. By offering this flexible cancellation policy, we aim to make your journey with us as stress-free as

possible. Should you need any assistance or have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact our friendly customer support team.

Thank you for choosing Excursions Tickets Direct. We look forward to providing you with unforgettable memories on your upcoming adventure!
html.es:
Política de cancelación

En Excursions Tickets Direct, entendemos que los planes pueden cambiar inesperadamente, y nos esforzamos por ofrecer a nuestros clientes una experiencia sin complicaciones. Nuestra política de cancelación está diseñada para ofrecer flexibilidad y adaptarse a diversas situaciones.

1. Anulaciones estándar

Los clientes pueden cancelar sus reservas hasta 24 horas antes del día previsto para la actividad sin incurrir en ningún gasto. Esto le da libertad para ajustar sus planes con antelación, sin hacer preguntas.

2. Cancelaciones por motivos de salud

Damos prioridad al bienestar de nuestros clientes y reconocemos que pueden surgir problemas de salud imprevistos. En tales casos, aceptamos cancelaciones con la condición de que se presente como prueba un justificante médico válido expedido por un médico colegiado. Esto garantiza que sus verdaderos problemas de salud se aborden con empatía y comprensión.

3. Opciones de reprogramación

La vida es impredecible, y lo entendemos. Si, por cualquier otro motivo, no puede acudir al viaje programado, le ofrecemos la comodidad de cambiar su reserva a otro día adecuado. De este modo, no se perderá las increíbles experiencias que le ofrecemos.

Nuestro principal objetivo es crear una experiencia positiva y agradable para nuestros valiosos clientes. Con esta política de cancelación flexible, queremos que su viaje con nosotros sea lo menos estresante posible.

posible. Si necesita ayuda o tiene alguna pregunta, no dude en ponerse en contacto con nuestro amable equipo de atención al cliente.

Gracias por elegir Excursions Tickets Direct. Esperamos poder ofrecerle recuerdos inolvidables en su próxima aventura.
